title: Mazloom-e-Karbala Ka Chehlum Hai Karbala Me
body:
Mazloom-e-Karbala Ka Chehlum Hai Karbala Me
Banu Ke Dilruba Ka Chehlum Hai Karbala Me
1.Markhad Pa Aakey Madar Aansu Baharahi Hai
Hum Shakle Mustafa Ka Chehlum Hai Karbala Me
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Naize Uochal Ke Paani Baichan Horaha Hai
Abbas-e-Bawafa Ka Chehlum Hai Karbala Me
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Be Shoor-o-Shain Zainab Faryaad Karrahi Hai
Farzande Mustafa Ka Chehlum Hai Karbala Me
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Laaye Kahan Chadar Phoolou Ki Ibne Sarwar
Pyase Shah-e-Huda Ka Chehlum Hai Karbala Me
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Har Ek Dil Hazi Hai Sar Peet Aaye Razi Tu
Aulad-e-Fatima Ka Chehlum Hai Karbala Me
